title: Hermann Niermann Scholarships

provider.name: Hermann Niermann Foundation/European Institute for German Language

summary: Support for highly qualified international students and researchers in German Studies for study and research stays in Germany across multiple funding lines ranging from short stays to doctoral projects.

degree_levels.notes: Covers BA, MA, postgraduate study/specialisation, and doctoral projects. Postdoctoral researchers are also targeted in track F.

subject_areas.notes: German Studies, German language, literature and culture.

nationality.notes: Bosnia and Herzegovina, Bulgaria, Croatia, Czech Republic, Estonia, Hungary, Kosovo, Latvia, Lithuania, Montenegro, North Macedonia, Poland, Romania, Serbia, Slovakia, Slovenia and Ukraine.

residence.notes: Research/study stays take place in Germany; applicants apply from their home countries.

mandatory.text: Depending on the purpose; usually at least a Bachelor's degree is required.

funding.description: The amount of the grant depends on the purpose. It ranges from 950 EUR per month for a short stay to 2,250 EUR per month for a research project.

application_rounds.notes: Application deadlines are published on the programme website.

steps.text: All application forms and further information on the application procedure can be found on the programme website.

sources.title: Hermann Niermann Foundation/European Institute for German Language: Hermann Niermann Scholarships - DAAD - Deutscher Akademischer Austauschdienst
sources.notes: International students and researchers can receive funding for physical study and research stays in Germany. Postdoctoral track F is excluded from student scope, but mixed lines are included.

review_notes: Funding line F is for postdoctoral researchers and is outside student scope, but other lines cover students/doctoral candidates.
